view: PA frontal chest radiograph (erect), conventional orientation with an external "L" marker at the upper right of the image (patient's left)
technical_quality: Adequate: fair inspiration (~9 posterior ribs), acceptable penetration with vertebral bodies faintly visible through the heart, minimal rotation, scapulae partially projected over the upper lateral lung fields. No lines, tubes, clips or pacemaker; only an external side marker.

abnormalities.finding: Enlarged, dense right hilum with a lobulated mass-like opacity (hilar mass or lymphadenopathy)

Ill-defined lobulated opacity extending from the right hilum into the medial right lower zone, partially obscuring the right heart border (suggesting right middle lobe atelectasis/consolidation or infrahilar mass extension)
Mild elevation of the right hemidiaphragm (possible right-sided volume loss)
Prominent left hilum with rounded density (possible hilar lymphadenopathy or enlarged pulmonary artery)
Mild superior mediastinal widening with right paratracheal fullness

description_zh: 胸部正面X光（PA），吸氣量尚可、無明顯旋轉，未見任何導管、引流管、手術夾或心律調節器，僅見外部L標記。右側肺門增大且密度增加，並有分葉狀緻密影自肺門向下延伸至右中下肺野內側，部分遮蔽右心緣，需考慮右肺門腫塊或淋巴結腫大合併右中葉塌陷／實變；左側肺門亦略顯突出。右側橫膈輕度上抬，上縱膈略寬伴右氣管旁飽滿、主動脈弓突出；雙側肋膈角銳利，未見氣胸或肋膜積液，心臟大小尚在正常範圍，骨骼與軟組織未見明顯病灶。
